cache_audit.planner_stage: _stage uses a completed result only when resume is requested, output exists, and cache_inputs contract matches; without cache_inputs, it does not reuse an old output through a contract.
cache_audit.case_groups: outer stage deliberately uses resume=False on planner resume; inner per-batch cache requires chapter/batch/route/unit-material/task signatures, preserving retry of failed batches.
cache_audit.owner: only successful complete owner outputs matching owner/material/identity contract replace authoritative details; failed or unresolved work remains visible.
cache_audit.arrangement: completed validated result may be reused by input/config signature; --force bypasses it; reexport revalidates current code without a model call.
cache_audit.writer: standalone writer CLI has no full BODY cache contract; a batch driver must use explicit unit manifest/output roots.
cache_audit.assembly: missing units fail by default and fake/simulated outputs are rejected; --allow-partial is diagnostic only.
cache_audit.operator_check: Use a fresh run root or record exact --resume root, then inspect RUN_STATE.json, stage contracts, source/material signatures, and commit before accepting any cache hit. Historical case_chain_restore/body07 artifacts must not satisfy a missing current stage.
cache_audit.known_risk: Planner cache contracts hash effective inputs, current prompt text, model, output limit, and thinking limit, but not repository commit SHA. An old result can match if those fields happen to match while implementation code changed elsewhere; fresh output roots are required for a clean rehearsal.
